note: Literature directly reports a homozygous SGSM3 founder variant in Ashkenazi Jews with a carrier frequency of approximately 1 in 52 in gnomAD.

evidence.text: gnomAD population data suggests that approximately 1 in 52 Ashkenazi Jewish individuals is a carrier of the SGSM3 founder variant associated with autosomal recessive intellectual disability.
